newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 13.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 13.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Monday:
* On Friday, the Dow Jones ended at 6,703.67 points, up 78 points. PLDT's ADR rose by $3 5/8 at $56 1/2.
* On Friday, the peso closed at 26.337 to a U.S. dollar from 26.342.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,262.14, up 38.78.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate was unchanged at 10.53125 pct.
* The Central Bank says it may cut by another two percentage points the reserve requirement imposed on bank deposits by the second half of this year. (BULLETIN/PHILIPPINE STAR/INQUIRER)

* The Department of Energy assures public fuel price adjustment this month will not result in hefty power rate increases as based on Singapore Posted Prices, the benchmark for domestic pump prices, the price of fuel oil has moved up by merely 2.47 centavos per litre and is now starting to stabilise. (MANILA STANDARD)
* Mabuhay Vinyl Corp starts initial public offering today of 223 million shares at 1.90 pesos a share. Target listing date is on February 5. (MANILA STANDARD/TIMES JOURNAL)

* The Manila Electric Co (Meralco) may not be able to keep its promise of not increasing rates until the year 2000 if a collective bargaining agreement (CBA) which calls for a 2 billion peso outlay over a two-year period pushes through. (TIMES JOURNAL)

* The Lorenzo family which owns majority interest in Pepsi-Cola Products Philippines Inc (PCPPI) signs memorandum of understanding with Guoco Holdings Philippines Inc to acquire a 51 percent stake in PCPPI. (BUSINESSWORLD)
